params.comment: A ~/ path is under home, an absolute one is itself, any other is under the repo root. project_match (default the repo's own project folder), managed_claude_md (default the platform's managed policy CLAUDE.md) and code_os_checkout (default the Git Crafter checkout this collector runs from) name no path here. kept_rules: file names of path-scoped rules a repo keeps for the account's other repos; instructions.unused sets them aside, as desktop-app.json's kept_kinds sets aside servers. None by default.

label: Protected clauses missing
means: Clauses Git Crafter protects that are gone from the installed rule or skill Claude actually reads.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: every clause Git Crafter protects holds in the installed copy, as Git Crafter tools/clause_check.py requires of its own checkout
source: state: each clause in Git Crafter tools/protected_clauses.json (local checkout, params.code_os_checkout) against the installed copy, rules/ as ~/.claude/rules/ and skills/ as ~/.claude/skills/ (params.installed_from_code_os), lowercase with whitespace collapsed as clause_check.py does; an unreadable copy is not measured

label: Rules, skills and agents unused
means: Path-scoped rules, skills and agents that no recent session loaded or called.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: each rule, skill and agent earns its place in recent work or is removed; a listed one costs tokens every session
source: the last params.unused_sessions (default 50) main sessions by start, with their subagents: Skill calls and typed slash commands by name, Agent calls by subagent_type (none is general-purpose), and a paths rule when a Read, Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit call touched a matching file under the session's folder; rules with no paths load every session and are left out, and so are the path-scoped rules in params.kept_rules, kept for the account's other repos. A user-level skill or rule counts only when this repo holds its source, by params.installed_from_code_os. Another tool's, used in other projects, is not this repo's to remove; its listing still counts in instructions.description_tokens. N = 50 sessions, so a skill used now and then still recurs within it; a smaller N calls a skill in use unused

label: Lines in the largest always-loaded file
means: The largest file the repo controls that loads every session: a CLAUDE.md, a rule or the memory index head.
goal_source: goal from the Claude Code memory docs' size guidance, "target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file. Longer files consume more context and reduce adherence" (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03), applied to each always-loaded file the repo controls; near band: template default, twice that
source: state: line breaks of the repo's CLAUDE.md files, its rules with no paths, the house rules with no paths whose source the repo holds (params.installed_from_code_os), and the head of MEMORY.md that loads (200 lines or 25 KB, code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03); the largest. The managed and user CLAUDE.md are not the repo's; hook output is blockers.hook_tokens_per_session

label: Always-loaded instruction tokens
means: Standing instructions every session loads before it starts, the memory index aside; every call carries them.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the always-loaded files within a few thousand tokens, in line with the memory docs' target of under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03); the MEMORY index is counted apart
source: state: bytes / 4 of exactly these files: the platform's managed policy CLAUDE.md (params.managed_claude_md), ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the repo's CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md, and the ~/.claude/rules/*.md and .claude/rules/*.md files whose frontmatter has no paths (a paths rule loads only with matching files, code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03); an absent file adds nothing. Not the MEMORY index (instructions.memory_index_tokens), skill and agent listings (instructions.description_tokens) or hook output (blockers.hook_tokens_per_session)

label: Memory index tokens
means: What the head of the project memory index costs on every call.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a one-line-per-entry index, as the memory docs ask Claude to keep it (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03), stays a few hundred tokens; past the first 200 lines or 25KB nothing loads at all
source: state: bytes / 4 of params.memory_index in the params.projects_dir folder ending params.project_match (default the repo's own project folder), up to its first params.memory_head_lines lines or memory_head_bytes bytes, whichever comes first: the part that loads (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03)

label: Skill and agent listing tokens
means: Names and descriptions of every skill and agent, which load into each session so Claude can pick one.
goal_source: goal from Claude Code's skill listing budget, 1% of the model's context window (code.claude.com/docs/en/skills, Skill descriptions are cut short, read 2026-11-03), at a 200,000-token window = 2,000 tokens; past it descriptions are dropped. Near band at 1.5 times
source: state: bytes / 4 of the name, description and when_to_use frontmatter of every .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, ~/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md and .claude/agents/*.md; a missing name counts its folder or file name. Plugin skills are left out
